messages:
alex.k: Heads-up — I'm opening a small docs PR to add a troubleshooting snippet for 429s when clients hit long contexts + batching. Will include an SDK backoff example and a fallback-to-smaller-model pattern. Need a quick reviewer.
rachel.docs: SG. Can you add a short migration note for teams using the unified SDK and a link to the err-ref 429 section? Keep it compact.
tomas: pinging @rachel.docs — also please include a short bit distinguishing trimming context vs streaming + fallback. I have a tiny JS snippet we can drop in.
alex.k: snippet (draft):
```js
// short backoff + fallback example
await client.generate({
  model: 'gpt-4o-infer',
  prompt,
  max_tokens: 512,
  retry: { retries: 3, backoff: (i) => 100 * (2 ** i) }
});
// fallback idea: on repeated 429 -> retry with 'gpt-4o-lite' or trim prompt
```
Think we should also show sending X-Redwood-Retry-After header and reading response headers.
rachel.docs: looks good. Use the new retry-header example we merged last sprint (the one with Retry-After parsing). Also add a one-line note about SLA behavior for Dedicated customers.
linda-eng: adding to that — can we explicitly call out 429s caused by Dedicated quota vs global throttling? one sentence is enough.
alex.k: good call, added a one-liner and a link to capacity docs in the PR description.
ci-bot: PR #4187 created by alex.k — docs/err-ref/429-addition. CI: docs-build failed — broken link in 'capacity' anchor.
alex.k: fixing link now.
alex.k: pushed commit 3f4a9 — link fix.
ci-bot: CI passed for #4187 — build OK, staging deploy complete.
rachel.docs: I'll do a quick pass tomorrow AM. @tomas can you sanity-check the JS snippet formatting and make sure we match the latest SDK call shape?
tomas: formatting nit: prefer .generate over .completion and include a streaming pseudo-example for trimming cases. Also add a tiny note about KV cache concerns when switching models mid-request.
alex.k: updated snippet, added streaming pseudo and a short section 'When to fallback vs trim' — kept it concise.
rachel.docs: approved. merging in 10 if no objections.
linda-eng: no objections, thanks — nice and clear.
alex.k: merged. Adding cross-link to SDK samples page and tagging in changelog.
ci-bot: PR #4187 merged by rachel.docs.
